source.note: phoneDSH-owned proactive settings/decision vectors; there is no dsh-bot upstream file. Routine-due fields reuse routine-notification.schema.json.

delta: Freeze the effective proactive settings document: persisted ProactiveSettings fields, ProactivePolicyConfiguration fuse fields and ProactiveEngine deliveryKinds.
Freeze the ProactiveEngine decision order: routine-held/routine-quiet before mode-off, mode-off before policy, policy before fuse, fuse before delivery.
Freeze did/would/skip as the decision enum; mode-off, fuse, quiet-hours, dnd, missing-bot, delivery-failed and delivery-unavailable are reason values.
Freeze the strict fuse boundary (4th did allowed, 5th refused), would-mode fuse accounting, and that DND/quiet/delivery failures do not contribute.
Freeze on-mode deliveryKinds filtering: a non-deliverable kind records would/would-only-kind and contributes no fuse.
Freeze dedupeKey derivation and replacement semantics: the key is a stable notification identifier, never a suppression window.
Freeze notification copy defaults, trimming and 120/500-character clipping, plus the row deep link shape.
Freeze that a routine-due local notification is a separate RoutineScheduledNotification path, not a ProactiveDecision, and consumes no fuse.
